turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I have a free weekend for once, and I can't decide what to do with it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me describe everything first, and then I'll ask for your thoughts.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first idea is a road trip to the beach town two hours away and staying overnight.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's just staying home, sleeping in, and finally finishing that series I started.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is going to the food festival downtown on Saturday with a couple of friends.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is tackling the garden, which has been a total mess since spring.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you've been feeling worn out, staying home and resting might be the best gift to yourself. The beach trip is the most memorable option if you've got some energy. The food festival is a nice middle ground, fun but close by.
